maintenance.enableDescription: New business and ordinary user requests will be refused. Already accepted continuation work and the authenticated administrator station remain available.
maintenance.disableDescription: Ordinary admission will resume after the authoritative maintenance transition commits. Authentication and all resource gates remain unchanged.
maintenance.authorityRevision: Authority revision {{revision}}. Success, conflict, or an unknown response reloads this singleton and never repeats the transition automatically.
maintenance.stewardCannotDisable: Stewards cannot disable maintenance. Use the authenticated administrator station to restore ordinary admission.
maintenance.reasonInvalid: Enter a non-blank reason no larger than 4,096 UTF-8 bytes.

logs.stewardEmptyBody: No visible records match the current filters.
logs.noAttempts: This projection does not expose upstream attempts.
logs.filterInvalid: The status code or time range is invalid.

charity.accessLost: Charity management access is no longer available.
charity.confirmReview: I confirm this review result and its whole-donation consequences.
charity.deleteModelBody: The logical model and its binding projection are removed. Existing accepted work keeps its frozen authority.
charity.keyEditableAfterApproval: Key limits become editable after approval.
charity.noBindingsBody: Add one or more role-safe candidates below.
charity.pendingReviewBody: Approval requires a complete setting for every currently surviving key. The donor description, physical source, and endpoint ownership cannot be edited here.

validation.priceLimit: Price limit must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.countLimits: Call and token limits must be canonical integers no greater than 9,000,000,000,000,000.
validation.tokenReserve: Token reserve must be an integer from 0 through 2,147,483,647.
validation.safeNote: Reviewer-safe note must be at most 256 characters and contain no control characters.
validation.reviewReason: Review reason is required and must be at most 1,024 characters.
validation.expiry: Whole-donation expiry must be a valid supported date.
validation.completeSettings: Approval requires a complete setting for every surviving key.
validation.modelIdentity: Provider and model are required, limited to 64 characters, and cannot reuse the [公益] prefix.
validation.modelPrices: Every price must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.discountPercent: Discount percent must be an integer from 0 through 100.
validation.discountDates: Discount dates must be valid and the end must be later than the start.
